page.overview:
What is Artificial Pokémon?

Artificial Pokémon are Pokémon created intentionally or unintentionally by humans or other Pokémon and did not originally exist in the wild.

Magnemite, an /-type, which evolves into Magneton, another /-type, have powers that allow them to float from the ground. They also match onto power plants to gain electrical power, giving them their -type. Even though it is not clearly stated that Magnemite was created artificially, they share traits with many artificial Pokémon, like having robotic parts. Magneton have also been depicted in sketches on the Ruins of Alph which states they have been around a long time.

In Generation IV, Magneton gained an evolution into Magnezone.

Kadabra isn’t technically man made but it was a boy with psychic powers who woke up and became this Pokémon. Which technically means it’s not a natural Pokémon.
